name: Bulk Put Unit Pricing Matrix (Async)
description: Asynchronously manage the rent pricing structure for units

attributes.name: PricingMatrix
attributes.description: Array of objects that defines the rent pricing structure and lease terms for a unit

attributes.name: UnitId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the rent pricing matrix entry. A unit should only be included once per call

responseFields.name: JobId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the asynchronous job
